environment.description: ECS Fargate service in staging environment (acme-staging-reporting-cluster). The service connects to LaunchDarkly project 'acme-staging' where the flag 'report-dynamic-filter-v2' was toggled off on 2024-01-15 after the migration rollback decision. The flag's off-variation returns false and the targeting toggle is set to 'off' (all contexts receive off-variation regardless of rules). The SDK is initialized with sdk-stg-REDACTED key pointing to the staging environment. Additionally, the container's task definition includes a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) and drops all Linux capabilities. The service mesh (AWS App Mesh) virtual node has a timeout policy of 5s on the route, though this is primarily for reliability.
